en: Could you be looking for Mikhail?
If so he just now hurried off somewhere.
Maybe he had a date with some young debutante.  Keeekkekeke.
For heaven's sake why are you dawdling about?
One month has already passed since the incident.
The environment around us has changed completely.
However, Mikhail is serving as our butler just as before.
Father, as usual, is doing nothing but research, research, research.
I wish he would spend a bit more time with me.  It's just a smidge, but some days I can feel a little lonely.
But, that's okay.  Because no matter what, now I am.....
